channel.title: River 川
channel.description: Short texts by Yoso that move like a quiet river: fragments of a daily practice, read slowly, one after another.

item.title: Before reaching the shore
item.description:
Before reaching the shore,
in the quiet sea of abstraction;
seize the mind.

– Yoso

item.title: To feel with opened eyes
item.description:
To feel with opened eyes,
to listen with the heart,
to speak with truth.

– Yoso

item.title: Wind’s Natural Soul
item.description:
Wind’s natural soul…
Leading me into the unknown…
Transcendental flow.

– Yoso

item.title: Breathe in
item.description:
Breathe in…
Breathe out…
The energy that connects all forms…
Infinite chains of chemical reactions…
Trillions of cells living within…
What am I?

– Yoso

item.title: Kind loving love
item.description:
Kind loving love,
Kind loving love,
Kind loving love.

– Yoso

item.title: Submissiveness
item.description:
Submissiveness,
alien to the shining soul,
breathing union is.

– Yoso

item.title: I surrender to the flow
item.description:
I surrender to the flow…
Reaching the depths of my heart…
Union’s Embrace.

– Yoso

item.title: Spring Energy
item.description:
Spring Energy,
Blessing our hearts with auspicious light.
Each blossom, a vow of harmony.
With gratitude, I honour your transience.

– Yoso

item.title: Awakening Mind
item.description:
Awakening mind…
That which is conscious…
For the good of sentience.

– Yoso

item.title: Present, mindful now
item.description:
Present, mindful now.
Peaceful heart, a quiet mind.
Harmony’s embrace.

– Yoso

item.title: To each cell
item.description:
Hands in prayer,
I bow respectfully to each cell in my body,
and to the life in you.

– Yoso

item.title: Heal yourself to heal others
item.description:
Heal yourself to heal others,
heal others to heal yourself.

– Yoso

item.title: First Love, Then Form
item.description:
First love, then form.

– Yoso

item.title: There is no greater shock in life than birth
item.description:
There is no greater shock in life than birth,
unable to survive alone,
we believe in independence.
Death is clemency.

– Yoso

item.title: Existence itself
item.description:
Existence itself…
is death in its essence…
There is no presence without breath.

– Yoso

item.title: In modern times
item.description:
In modern times,
seeking distractions,
we acquire knowledge,
revealing truth,
fearing our instincts.

– Yoso

item.title: Eternal wisdom
item.description:
Within life itself lies the knowledge!
Eternal wisdom,
if only we listened.

– Yoso

item.title: End of Summer Full moon
item.description:
End of Summer Full moon,
Bright in the East…
I could feel the cold wind in the morning rise…
Summer afternoon…
Feeling the Rain coming when you set your light…
It took me half a century to recognize, that both the Sun and you…
Made me who I have become…
A modern man seeking revenge on modern civilisation..
For hiding your beauty for so long..
I am back, and choose to celebrate your dance and gentle light, until the last day of my winter…
Let me celebrate many sunrises…

– Yoso

item.title: Being One
item.description:
Being One.
Becoming One.
One.

– Yoso

item.title: With each petal in the wind
item.description:
With each petal in the wind,
I vow to dedicate myself to prosperity and harmony for sentient life.

– Yoso

item.title: Do not love Love
item.description:
Do not love Love,
be love,
love.

– Yoso

item.title: The spring awakes
item.description:
The spring awakes,
The Golden Heart is here!
Pure Consciousness.

– Yoso

item.title: Your Mind is your home
item.description:
Your mind is your home.
Bring it light,
bring it air,
bring it love.

– Yoso

item.title: With each blossom
item.description:
With each blossom,
I vow to dedicate myself to prosperity and harmony for sentient life.

– Yoso

item.title: A quiet river
item.description:
Thank you for always being by my side.
With you, my heart flows like a quiet river.

– Yoso
